facts.text: If a business charges a restocking fee, it must disclose the existence and amount of the fee to customers.
facts.quote: A. A business in this state that charges a restocking fee on a product the business sells shall disclose the existence of the fee and the amount of the fee to a customer in accordance with this section.

facts.text: Violating these restocking fee disclosure requirements is an unlawful practice subject to investigation and enforcement.
facts.quote: C. An act or practice in violation of this section is an unlawful practice under section 44-1522. The attorney general may investigate and take appropriate action as prescribed by chapter 10, article 7 of this title.

facts.text: A restocking fee is defined as a fee charged for restocking a good upon its return or exchange.
facts.quote: D. For the purposes of this section, "restocking fee" means a fee charged by a business for restocking of the good purchased on its return or exchange.
